wok-pollo-peperoni-riso-basmati.name: Chicken stir-fry with peppers, carrots and courgettes; basmati rice
wok-pollo-peperoni-riso-basmati.description: Cook the rice, stir-fry the chicken and vegetables in the wok, then combine and season.

pasta-melanzane-pomodoro-ricotta.name: Classic pasta with fresh tomato, aubergine and ricotta
pasta-melanzane-pomodoro-ricotta.description: Brown the aubergine, add the tomato and stir the pasta through with the ricotta.

frittata-forno-bietole-ricotta.name: Baked frittata with chard and ricotta; tomato salad
frittata-forno-bietole-ricotta.description: Mix eggs, chard and ricotta, bake in the oven and serve with the tomatoes.

noodles-wok-uova-verdure.name: Wok noodles with egg, carrots, courgettes and peas
noodles-wok-uova-verdure.description: Stir-fry the vegetables, add the eggs and noodles and season with soy sauce.

merluzzo-pomodoro-olive-cous-cous.name: Cod fillets with tomato and olives; couscous and broccoli
merluzzo-pomodoro-olive-cous-cous.description: Cook the cod with tomato, spring onion and Taggiasca olives and serve with saffron couscous and almonds.

wrap-frittata-hummus.name: Wraps with frittata, hummus, lettuce and carrots
wrap-frittata-hummus.description: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic for a spicy hummus, then fill the flatbreads with vegetables and Emmental.

gamberi-zucchine-skottle.name: Skottle prawns and courgettes with toasted bread and cherry tomatoes
gamberi-zucchine-skottle.description: Brown the prawns and courgettes with garlic and shallot, deglaze with white wine and serve on toasted bread.

uova-pomodoro-padella.name: Eggs in tomato sauce
uova-pomodoro-padella.description: Soften the onion, cook the cherry tomatoes for 5 min, add the eggs and finish covered.

polpette-melanzane-forno.name: Baked aubergine balls
polpette-melanzane-forno.description: Brown the diced aubergine, mix with egg, breadcrumbs and caciocavallo, bake for 40 min.

pappardelle-alfredo.name: Pappardelle Alfredo
pappardelle-alfredo.description: Melt the butter, add half the Parmesan and some pasta water, then stir in the rest of the Parmesan.

pasta-pesto-genovese.name: Pasta with Genoese pesto
pasta-pesto-genovese.description: Cook the pasta and dress it with a jar of ready-made Genoese pesto.

hamburger-cavallo.name: Horse meat burgers
hamburger-cavallo.description: Cook the horse meat burgers and serve them in buns.

pasta-tonno.name: Tuna pasta
pasta-tonno.description: Fry garlic and anchovies, add drained tuna and tomato, then finish with parsley and basil.

spaghetti-pomodoro.name: Spaghetti with tomato sauce
spaghetti-pomodoro.description: Fry the garlic, add the tomato and basil, then stir in Parmesan to taste.

pasta-sugo-pesce.name: Pasta with fish sauce
pasta-sugo-pesce.description: Fry garlic and anchovies, add the fish sauce and stir through the fresh pasta.

penne-baffo.name: Penne al baffo
penne-baffo.description: Brown the ham, add crushed peeled tomatoes and cream, then stir the penne through with parsley.

pasta-zucca-salsiccia-robiola.name: Pasta with squash, sausage and robiola
pasta-zucca-salsiccia-robiola.description: Brown the sausage and onion, cook the squash for 10 min, stir through with robiola and pasta water.

orecchiette-broccoli.name: Orecchiette with broccoli
orecchiette-broccoli.description: Boil the broccoli, fry garlic and anchovies, then blend everything and stir the pasta through with Parmesan to taste.

pasta-crema-peperoni.name: Pasta with creamy pepper sauce
pasta-crema-peperoni.description: Stew the peppers with onion, blend with ricotta and milk and coat the paccheri with the sauce.

bistecche-tonno-skottle.name: Skottle tuna steaks
bistecche-tonno-skottle.description: Marinate the tuna with oil, lemon and spices, then cook on the skottle over high heat for 3 minutes per side.

branzino-barbecue.name: Barbecued sea bass fillets
branzino-barbecue.description: Cook the sea bass fillets skin side first, 3 minutes per side, with oil, salt and pepper.

sovracosce-pollo-griglia.name: Grilled chicken thighs
sovracosce-pollo-griglia.description: Marinate the thighs with oil, lemon and spices for 6 hours, then barbecue for 4 minutes per side.

burrito-vegan.name: Vegan burrito
burrito-vegan.description: Warm the vegan strips, fill the bread with beans, guacamole, sweet potato and sweetcorn and roll up.

caviale-melanzane-panino.name: Sandwich with aubergine caviar, grilled vegetables and feta
caviale-melanzane-panino.description: Fill Lebanese bread with aubergine caviar, grilled vegetables, feta, pickles, raisins and coriander.

riso-curry-giappone.name: Japanese curry rice with minced pork and pepper
riso-curry-giappone.description: Cook the rice first; in the wok brown the pork, onion and pepper, add the curry and serve over the rice.

omelette-spinaci-montasio.name: Spinach and Montasio omelette
omelette-spinaci-montasio.description: Cook the eggs in a pan, fill with baby spinach and Montasio and fold over.

straccetti-pollo-limone.name: Lemon chicken strips
straccetti-pollo-limone.description: Brown the floured chicken strips with garlic, then add lemon, water and herbs.

riso-lenticchie-zucca.name: Rice with lentils and squash
riso-lenticchie-zucca.description: Cook the diced squash with garlic and water, then add cooked lentils and rice.

riso-wok-broccoli-gamberi.name: Wok-fried rice with broccoli and prawns
riso-wok-broccoli-gamberi.description: Blanch the broccoli; stir-fry prawns and ginger in the wok, then add cooked rice and soy sauce.

riso-cantonese-casa.name: Home-style Cantonese rice
riso-cantonese-casa.description: Dice the vegetables, beat the eggs, cook the rice and stir-fry everything in the wok with soy sauce.

zuppa-fagioli-veloce-guanciale.name: Quick bean soup with crispy guanciale
zuppa-fagioli-veloce-guanciale.description: Brown the guanciale, soften the red onion, add beans and stock and serve topped with the crispy guanciale.

piadine-pollo-hummus-carote.name: Flatbreads with hummus, chicken, carrots and salad
piadine-pollo-hummus-carote.description: Warm the flatbreads, spread with hummus and fill with chicken, carrots and salad.

orata-padella-patate-pomodorini.name: Pan-cooked sea bream fillets with potatoes and cherry tomatoes
orata-padella-patate-pomodorini.description: Brown cherry tomatoes and very thinly sliced potatoes, lay the fillets on top, deglaze with wine and cook covered.

lonza-maiale-limone.name: Lemon pork loin slices
lonza-maiale-limone.description: Pound and flour the slices, brown them with butter, garlic and lemon zest, then deglaze with lemon and honey.

fettine-pizzaiola-prezzemolo.name: Beef slices pizzaiola with parsley
fettine-pizzaiola-prezzemolo.description: Brown the slices with garlic, cook them covered in blended tomato and finish with parsley.

lenticchie-comidista.name: Spanish-style lentils (El Comidista)
lenticchie-comidista.description: Cook the lentils with half an onion, garlic and bay leaf, add potato and carrots, then blend the sofrito with paprika and cumin and stir it in.

pasta-robiola-speck.name: Pasta with robiola and speck
pasta-robiola-speck.description: Brown the diced speck, soften the spring onion in the same pan and stir the pasta through with robiola and pasta water.

pasta-ricotta-zafferano.name: Creamy ricotta and saffron pasta
pasta-ricotta-zafferano.description: Loosen the ricotta with saffron and pasta water, dress the spaghettoni and finish with pepper and sage.

couscous-verdure-tonno.name: Couscous with vegetables and tuna
couscous-verdure-tonno.description: Soak the couscous, stir-fry carrots, pepper and courgette, add tuna, kidney beans and soy sauce and finish with radishes and parsley.

couscous-verdure.name: Vegetable couscous
couscous-verdure.description: Stir-fry aubergines, peppers, carrots, courgettes and peas, then combine with turmeric couscous and finish with basil and almonds.

pappardelle-salsiccia-porri.name: Rustic pappardelle with sausage and leeks
pappardelle-salsiccia-porri.description: Brown the sausage with chilli and thyme, deglaze with red wine, add the leek and toss the pappardelle with Parmesan.

pollo-corn-flakes.name: Cornflake-crusted chicken breast
pollo-corn-flakes.description: Coat the chicken slices in flour, egg and paprika cornflakes, fry them and serve with a yoghurt, mayonnaise and lemon sauce.

piadine-bresaola-stracchino-pesto-rosso.name: Flatbreads with bresaola, stracchino and red pesto
piadine-bresaola-stracchino-pesto-rosso.description: Blend sun-dried tomatoes, almonds and basil; fill with bresaola, stracchino and rocket and warm in a pan.

riso-ceci-spinaci-mandorle.name: Turmeric rice with chickpeas and spinach
riso-ceci-spinaci-mandorle.description: Cook the basmati with turmeric; stir-fry chickpeas and spinach with tomatoes, stock and almond butter, then serve over the rice.

spaghetti-riso-tofu-verdure-wok.name: Wok rice noodles with tofu and vegetables
spaghetti-riso-tofu-verdure-wok.description: Stir-fry vegetables and smoked tofu, add the rice noodles and season with soy, barbecue sauce and sesame.

paccheri-radicchio-bresaola-ricotta-noci.name: Paccheri with radicchio and bresaola
paccheri-radicchio-bresaola-ricotta-noci.description: Adapted version: wilt the radicchio, stir through with ricotta and finish with bresaola and walnuts.

ditali-cremosi-zucca-ceci.name: Creamy ditali with squash and chickpeas
ditali-cremosi-zucca-ceci.description: Adapted version: cook the squash with sage and rosemary, blend part of it and add cooked chickpeas and ditali.

trofie-funghi-piselli-ricotta.name: Trofie with mushrooms, peas and ricotta
trofie-funghi-piselli-ricotta.description: Adapted version: brown the mushrooms, add the peas and stir the pasta through with ricotta, pasta water and parsley.

fusilli-ricotta-spinaci-noci.name: Fusilli with ricotta and spinach
fusilli-ricotta-spinaci-noci.description: Adapted version: wilt the spinach, blend with ricotta and pasta water, dress the fusilli and finish with walnuts and lemon.

wrap-fagioli-neri-cheddar.name: Black bean and cheddar wraps
wrap-fagioli-neri-cheddar.description: Fry the beans with onion and garlic; fill the tortillas with cheddar, lettuce, tomato, yoghurt sauce and Mexican salsa.

erbazzone-uova-strapazzate-stracchino.name: Erbazzone, scrambled eggs and stracchino
erbazzone-uova-strapazzate-stracchino.description: Bake the erbazzone following the packet; make the scrambled eggs and serve with the stracchino.

sandwich-uova-mozzarella-pomodoro-tacchi.name: Egg, mozzarella, tomato and turkey sandwich
sandwich-uova-mozzarella-pomodoro-tacchi.description: Fried eggs and mozzarella in the first layer; mayonnaise, tomato and turkey in the second. Three slices of bread each.
